About

Holographic Data File

I'm Sree Darshan V, currently pursuing a B.Com in Banking & Insurance at Sri Krishna College of Arts and Science, Coimbatore. Based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, I'm building a path across banking fundamentals, data tools and digital product thinking — with fintech as the space where those interests meet.

Between April and May 2026 I completed an internship at Sri Saravanaa Fabs Private Ltd., an ISO 9001:2015-certified sheet metal fabrication company, rotating across Production, Quality, Design, Sales, HR and Accounts — a hands-on look at how a company runs end to end.

Objective

"To become a successful professional with innovative ideas and a continuous thirst for knowledge, contributing to team success while promoting a positive and collaborative work environment."
